components.css: .ds-search{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;background:var(--surface,#fff);border:1px solid #87a5a7;border-radius:9px;padding:7px 8px 7px 17px;max-width:100%;color:var(--teal,#087a72);font-family:var(--font,'Source Sans 3',Arial,sans-serif)}.ds-search input{min-width:0;flex:1;border:0;outline:none;background:transparent;color:var(--ink,#163247);padding:6px 0;font:400 18px/1.5 var(--font,'Source Sans 3',Arial,sans-serif);height:43px;caret-color:var(--teal,#087a72)}.ds-search input::placeholder{color:#5c707d;opacity:1}.ds-search:focus-within{border-color:var(--teal,#087a72);outline:2px solid #b6d6cf;outline-offset:1px}.ds-search input:focus-visible{outline:none}.ds-search button{font:400 16px/1.5 var(--font,'Source Sans 3',Arial,sans-serif);cursor:pointer;text-align:left;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:9px;font-size:16px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.2;min-height:44px;padding:10px 16px;border-radius:7px;text-decoration:none;border:0;color:#fff;background:var(--teal,#087a72);height:45px;min-width:120px;font-size:17px}.ds-search button:hover{background:var(--teal-dark,#065e59)}.ds-search button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus,#c27619);outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Workspace navigation
components.description: Text tabs with a selected bottom rule and quiet record-count badges; mobile wraps.
components.css: .ds-tabs{display:flex;gap:27px;border-bottom:1px solid #bacdcb;overflow:auto}.ds-tabs>button{font:400 16px/1.5 var(--font,'Source Sans 3',Arial,sans-serif);cursor:pointer;text-align:left;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;white-space:nowrap;padding:10px 0 13px;font-size:16px;font-weight:600;min-height:44px;background:none;border:0;border-bottom:3px solid transparent;color:var(--muted,#526775)}.ds-tabs>button[aria-selected=true]{color:var(--teal-dark,#065e59);border-bottom-color:var(--teal,#087a72)}.ds-tabs>button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus,#c27619);outline-offset:3px}.ds-tabs span{font-size:13px;background:#e1eae7;color:#35575c;border-radius:5px;padding:1px 6px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}@media(max-width:600px){.ds-tabs{flex-wrap:wrap;gap:4px 16px;overflow:visible}.ds-tabs>button{font-size:15px;gap:6px;padding-top:9px;padding-bottom:12px}.ds-tabs span{font-size:11px;padding:1px 5px}}

components.css: .ds-node{font:400 16px/1.5 var(--font,'Source Sans 3',Arial,sans-serif);cursor:pointer;text-align:left;width:170px;min-height:65px;padding:10px 12px;background:var(--surface,#fff);color:var(--ink,#163247);border:1px solid #a8bfba;border-radius:9px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}.ds-node>span{min-width:0}.ds-node small{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted,#526775);display:block;margin-bottom:3px}.ds-node strong{font-size:13px;line-height:1.3;display:-webkit-box;-webkit-line-clamp:2;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;overflow:hidden;font-weight:600}.ds-node.is-center{background:var(--teal-dark,#065e59);color:#fff;border-color:var(--teal-dark,#065e59)}.ds-node.is-center small{color:#c5e6dd}.ds-node:hover{outline:2px solid #93b8ae;outline-offset:2px}.ds-node:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus,#c27619);outline-offset:3px}

narrative.overview:
PIAUIGRAPH is an approachable reading and finding tool for public procurement. Deep blue ink, teal signs and warm reading surfaces make the catalog recognizable without asking people to learn an auditing interface. Ordinary Portuguese, clear financial labels and visible official sources support readers across literacy levels.

Search and flat results lead the implemented civic explorer. Geographic context, paired value bars and documentary relationships support a chosen record. The user explicitly replaced the former burgundy, serif and map-first direction; those decisions are superseded. This is a record of shipped code, not a composition proposal.
keyCharacteristics: Blue ink and teal wayfinding on warm paper and white surfaces.
One self-hosted sans-serif family for headings, reading, controls and figures.
Flat record rows, familiar filters and modest rounded controls.
Named financial stages and factual visuals with visible source access.
Responsive reading order, wrapping mobile tabs and alternative list access.

rules.name: The Evidence Color Rule
rules.body: Color identifies an action, selection, published stage or coverage state. It never establishes wrongdoing.

rules.name: The One Reading Voice Rule
rules.body: Use Source Sans 3 across the interface; establish hierarchy through size, weight and spacing.

rules.name: The Reading Surface Rule
rules.body: Use borders and tonal changes for reading structure; reserve the recorded drop shadows for overlays.

dos: **Do** keep search and flat, readable results ahead of supporting geographic context.
**Do** use the blue/teal palette and one self-hosted Source Sans 3 reading voice.
**Do** print financial-stage labels, values, sources and coverage limitations beside the relevant visual.
**Do** retain visible focus, native filters, wrapping mobile tabs and map/network list alternatives.
**Do** disclose graph scope and drawing limits while keeping the full returned node list available.
donts: **Don't** restore the superseded burgundy/serif visual world.
**Don't** use color, network proximity or a comparison difference to imply fraud.
**Don't** substitute decorative charts or invented edges for documented data.
**Don't** call an estimate, approved result or published contract value a payment.
**Don't** turn the graph's internal scrolling canvas into horizontal page overflow.
